svg.title: Orbyt : Group Based Accountability Platform
svg.desc: Orbyt : Group Based Accountability Platform. A multi-tenant platform where friend groups commit to daily DSA practice and keep each other accountable. Multi-tenant group architecture; JWT authentication with HTTP-only cookies; Google OAuth and invite-code onboarding; RBAC and group-level authorization; 30+ REST APIs; Controller → Service → Repository architecture; Leaderboards, streaks and habit tracking; TanStack Query for server state; PostgreSQL + Drizzle ORM; Built for 35+ active users. Stack: React · Next.js · Tailwind CSS · Node.js · Express · PostgreSQL · Drizzle · JWT · OAuth2 · TanStack Query

text.tspan: A multi-tenant platform where friend groups commit to daily DSA
